board: MH-SR602 (HW-438) mini PIR motion sensor module (round black board with white dome lens, 3-pin header OUT, +, -)
reason: Check passed on ESP32 and Pico (spec, wiring, design checks, breadboard, simulator test 'MOTION=1' with motion on, PCB DRC clean, footprint).
